name: 10960 · Nyack, NY
findings: ZIP 10960 (Nyack) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10960 (Nyack) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
